name: OUTLIER
description: An independent identity for experimental streetwear. A displaced square, bold rust-red fields, and sharply condensed typography champion the beauty of not fitting in.
heading: bebas
rules: One square is deliberately displaced; the rest remain on the grid.
Use condensed display type at dramatic scale without stretching glyphs.
Keep care instructions plain and legible, separated from expressive graphics.

system.concept: Displaced registration blocks, garment-label grids, graphic material folds, and severe condensed lettering. An intentionally unstandard streetwear system with clear functional details.
headline: Wear your
own direction.
system.eyebrow: INDEPENDENT BY DESIGN / NO STANDARD ISSUE
features: Form with a distinct position and a useful place in your everyday.
Graphic construction that follows the idea all the way through.
An independent starting point, not a prescribed identity.
system.layoutNote: Oxide poster hero with condensed giant type and displaced fabric geometry. Square black CTA, strong grid rules, and utilitarian care-label captions.
